text.tspan: Mean income or consumption per day: 2017 vs. 2021 international-$2025
This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
Mean (international-$ in 2017 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Mean (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Data source: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)
Note: Depending on the country and year, the data relates to income (measured after taxes and benefits) or to consumption, per capita. Where
data for 2025 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2020 and 2030 is shown instead.
